en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Abdullah Bin Ja’far, from Muhammad Bin Isa, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Feed the Chard to your sick ones, meaning a leaf of it, for therein is a healing, and there is no cure with it, nor is there a suffering for it, and gifts the sleep to the patient, and keep away from its root for it agitates the black bile’.
en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from ‘Abd Allah ibn Ja‘far from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa who has said the following: “Abu al-Hassan, al-Rida’, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

Feed your patients beets, the leaves, because there is cure in it without illness or shock and it makes sleep of a patient more relaxing; but abstain from its roots because it stirs up al-Sawada ’ (a certain illness).”’
